description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and creating writable rename targets, primarily used for file operations such as renaming files or moving within a project. It defines functions that handle target resolution and ensuring writability, parameterized with generic types.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargets<T extends { containerPath: string }>(params: { resolveWritableRenameTargets
methods.description: Resolves the from and to targets for renaming, ensuring both are writable, and returns an object containing these targets.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge<T extends { containerPath: string }>( resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge
methods.description: Simplifies invoking resolveWritableRenameTargets by passing in a resolveTarget and ensureWritable functions, returning the same result.

methods.name: export function createWritableRenameTargetResolver<T extends { containerPath: string }>( createWritableRenameTargetResolver
methods.description: Generates a function that, given rename parameters, resolves and ensures targets are writable, encapsulating common logic.

ctags.name: from
ctags.pattern: /^  const from = params.resolveTarget({ filePath: params.from, cwd: params.cwd });$/

ctags.name: to
ctags.pattern: /^  const to = params.resolveTarget({ filePath: params.to, cwd: params.cwd });$/
